fullPassage:
The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal.

(B) The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of insuring that adequate amounts of food are available to the resident population. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the domestic farming system.

(A) However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world.

(C) Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by relying on both domestic production and imports.

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to ①<u>achieving</u> food security and a wide variety of mechanisms ②<u>have been developed</u> to realize this goal. The first issue governments face in achieving national food security is the problem of ③<u>insure</u> that adequate amounts of food are available to the resident population. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which ④<u>means</u> most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the domestic farming system.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ insure → insuring: 전치사 of 뒤에는 동명사(~ing)가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① achieving: 전치사 to 뒤 동명사, 적절
✅ ② have been developed: mechanisms(복수) + 현재완료 수동태, 적절
❌ ③ insure: the problem of + 동명사 → insuring
✅ ④ means: which의 선행사 self-sufficiency(단수), 적절
det.tip: 전치사 + 동명사(~ing): the problem of insuring

questions.passage: However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily ①<u>produced</u> within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly ②<u>sensitively</u> to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend ③<u>to vary</u> around the world. Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully ④<u>self-sufficient</u> in all food items.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② sensitively → sensitive: be동사 + 형용사. 부사(sensitively)가 아닌 형용사(sensitive)가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① produced: 과거분사 후치수식, 적절
❌ ② sensitively: are + 형용사 → sensitive (보어 위치)
✅ ③ to vary: tend to + 동사원형, 적절
✅ ④ self-sufficient: are + 형용사, 적절
det.tip: be + 형용사(보어): are sensitive (O) / are sensitively (X)

questions.passage: Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions ①<u>that</u> tend to vary around the world. Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, ②<u>depend</u> on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products. In general, the problem of ③<u>assuring</u> adequate food supplies is solved by ④<u>relying</u> on both domestic production and imports.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② depend → depends: The United States는 국가명으로 단수 취급.
det.analysis:
✅ ① that: 관계대명사, 선행사 conditions 수식, 적절
❌ ② depend: The United States(단수) → depends
✅ ③ assuring: 전치사 of 뒤 동명사, 적절
✅ ④ relying: 전치사 by 뒤 동명사, 적절
det.tip: 국가명은 복수형이라도 단수 취급: The United States depends

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ not easily producing → not easily produced: food items는 생산'되는' 대상이므로 과거분사.
det.analysis:
✅ ① have been developed: 수동태 현재완료, 적절
✅ ② which: 관계대명사, 앞 절 수식, 적절
❌ ③ producing: items는 생산의 대상 → produced(수동)
✅ ④ is solved: the problem(단수) + 수동태, 적절
det.tip: 능동(~ing) vs 수동(p.p.): items produced(생산된 품목)

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal. questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 빈칸에는 self-sufficiency(자급자족)가 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② self-sufficiency: 국내 농업에서 대부분의 식량이 나온다는 맥락
❌ ① dependency: 의존성은 반대 의미
❌ ③ vulnerability: 취약성은 목표 아님
❌ ④ diversity: 다양성은 문맥에 안 맞음
det.tip: self-sufficiency = 자급자족

questions.passage: Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, ①<u>depends</u> on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other ②<u>tropical</u> products. In general, the problem of ③<u>assuring</u> adequate food supplies is solved by ④<u>ignoring</u> both domestic production and imports.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ ignoring(무시하다) → relying on(의존하다): 국내 생산과 수입에 '의존'해서 해결한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① depends: 원문 그대로
✅ ② tropical: 원문 그대로
✅ ③ assuring: 원문 그대로
❌ ④ ignoring: 원문은 relying on → ignoring으로 바뀌어 부적절
det.tip: rely on(~에 의존하다) ↔ ignore(무시하다)

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security and a wide variety of mechanisms have been developed to realize this goal.
questions.stem:

det.analysis: ✅ T: 원문에 virtually every country가 식량 안보에 great importance를 부여한다고 명시
det.tip: virtually = 사실상, 거의

questions.passage: Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food comes from the domestic farming system. questions.stem:

det.analysis: ✅ T: 원문과 일치
det.tip: depend on imports = 수입에 의존하다

questions.passage: The governments of virtually every country on the planet attach great importance to achieving food security. Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency. questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: restrict food production to domestic farms
import food items not easily produced within the country
achieve complete self-sufficiency in all food items

det.korean: because 뒤 이유: 국내에서 쉽게 생산되지 않는 품목을 수입할 수 있으므로
det.analysis:
✅ ③ import food items: 자급자족이 불필요한 이유로 적절
❌ ① restrict: 제한은 반대
❌ ② eliminate: 기후 변동 제거는 불가능
❌ ④ complete self-sufficiency: 앞에서 불필요하다고 했음
det.tip: because + 이유. 자급자족 불필요 → 수입 가능

questions.passage: However, food security does not require food self-sufficiency because countries can import food items not easily produced within the country. Agricultural products are, after all, highly sensitive to climatic, soil and other conditions that tend to vary around the world. Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. The United States, for example, depends on imports for its supply of coffee, tea, bananas and other tropical products. In general, the problem of assuring adequate food supplies is solved by __________.
questions.stem: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 충분한 식량 공급은 국내 생산과 수입 둘 다에 의존함으로써 해결.
det.analysis:
✅ ① relying on both: 원문 결론과 일치
❌ ② exclusively: '오직' 국내만은 제한적
❌ ③ eliminating imports: 수입 제거는 반대
❌ ④ complete self-sufficiency: 불필요하다고 했음
det.tip: both A and B = A와 B 둘 다

questions.passage: Some governments have set goals of food self-sufficiency, which means most if not all of the food available in a country comes from the domestic farming system. det.analysis:

❌ ① 모든 정부 달성: some governments have set goals(설정만)
❌ ② 영향 안 받음: highly sensitive(매우 민감함)
❌ ③ 수입=자급자족: 자급자족은 국내 생산 의미

questions.passage: Even countries with extremely productive agricultural sectors are not fully self-sufficient in all food items. ch: 미국은 커피와 차의 공급을 수입에 의존한다.
극도로 생산적인 농업 부문을 가진 나라는 완전히 자급자족한다.
식량 공급 문제는 국내 생산과 수입의 병행으로 해결된다.
미국은 바나나와 기타 열대 산물을 수입한다.

det.korean: 원문: are not fully self-sufficient → 완전히 자급자족한다는 것은 불일치.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 수입 의존: 원문 일치
❌ ② 완전한 자급자족: not fully self-sufficient로 불일치
✅ ③ 병행 해결: 원문 일치
✅ ④ 열대 산물 수입: 원문 일치
det.tip: not fully = 완전히 ~하지 못하다
